name: Astral Ltd.
business_summary: Branded plastic plumbing (CPVC/PVC pipes and fittings, water tanks, bath ware) plus fast-growing adhesives/sealants and a new paints arm (Gem Paints), selling through distributors to housing, agri and infrastructure. FY26 sales Rs6,569 cr, TTM EBITDA margin 16%, PAT Rs576 cr; Q1 FY27 PAT Rs120 cr (+52% YoY, paints and adhesives accelerated, CNBC TV18 2026-08-12). Net cash. Market cap Rs37,442 cr at 63x P/E, near 52-week low; FII holding fell to 11.1% in the Sep quarter. Segment split is model knowledge.

exposures.mechanism: PVC/CPVC resin is ~45-50% of costs (model knowledge), priced off ethylene/EDC and imports. +10% resin => costs +4.5% = ~Rs255 cr/yr; ~70% passed through within the quarter, rest absorbed => ~-4% EBITDA transient; inventory gains from rising prices offset ~half; persistence 0.25-0.5 x EV/MCap 0.97 => ~-0.8. Empirical Brent/refining-margin sensitivities are positive (+0.81 t=1.5; +0.98 t=2.0), consistent with inventory-gain/restocking effects when prices rise, so range includes +1.0. Plastic-pipe makers expected to rebound as PVC prices recover (TradingView 2026-09-03).

evidence.note: TradingView: plastic pipe makers poised to bounce back in Q2 as PVC prices recover

exposures.mechanism: Plumbing, drainage and bathware are ~half new-construction driven. +10% housing sales => ~+4.5% volume x operating leverage 1.4 => EBITDA +6%; x0.97 x persistence 0.5 => ~+2.9, shaded to 2.5 for repair/replacement base.
Jal Jeevan Mission, AMRUT and municipal water/sewage projects use PVC/CPVC/HDPE; +10% capex growth => ~+2% volume => +1.5.
Agri pipes and rural plumbing demand follow rainfall/irrigation; +10% above LPA => ~+1.5% volume => +1.0.

Net cash business (interest Rs58 cr vs EBITDA Rs1,108 cr) so direct cost negligible; at 63x P/E the multiple is rate-duration sensitive, and housing finance costs weigh on demand. Repo hiked to 5.50% on 2026-10-07.

evidence.note: Google News: Reuters 2026-10-07 'India first hike in nearly 4 years'; SCC Online 'repo to 5.50%, calibrated tightening'

exposures.mechanism: Anti-dumping or safeguard duties on PVC resin imports (recurring DGTR cases; model knowledge, status unverified) raise resin prices by ~5-10% and squeeze pipe makers; domestic resin makers lobby for duty. +1 = new broad duties => ~-1.5 equity.
CPVC compound and some resin/additives are imported (est. ~15-20% of RM, model knowledge); +3% USD/INR => ~+0.5% costs => ~-3% EBITDA before pricing, persistence 0.25 => ~-0.8.
Empirical -1.14 per +25bp (t=-1.9, beta 0.75): a long-duration, low-beta quality compounder; higher global yields compress P/E 63x. Shaded for overlap with F_REPO_IN.

Empirical +1.10 per +5 VIX (t=+2.6) - Astral behaves defensively (beta 0.96) when risk-off hits cyclicals; plausible via domestic-consumption quality rotation, but weak causal story, so shaded to +0.8.

supply_chain.note: Largest plastic-pipe competitor; targets 15-17% pipe volume growth FY27 (Sahi 2026-08-19)
